title: The sprint skill's plan step asks for each planted check to run in the landing's check environment against a prototype of the fix
goal: the plan step of skills/sprint/SKILL.md says a planted check that reads query-log, spool or workspace state is run once through bl_base.run_check (its isolated CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA home) against a prototype of the fix before the start gate

run: import re,sys;t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m=re.search(r'\n## plan.*?\n## start',t,re.S);sys.exit(0 if m and 'run_check' in m.group(0) else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-hja7yu5k: the span story's check 1 passed from a shell and failed twice at the landing (step checks) because the landing runs checks with an empty CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA home, where kbmon --events printed the cursor 1.0.N.0 and the redaction rewrote it to 192.0.2.10 (a real bug, fixed in the sprint). Run through bl_base.run_check, the check shows it at plan time. The check reads the plan section for the word; a planned item adds the command form.
